officialBlogs.title: What Makes Anabacus Institution Unique in Abacus Instructor Training
officialBlogs.author: Ananya DM
officialBlogs.summary: Discover how ANA KNOWLEDGE ARENA PVT. LTD. (AKAPL) empowers aspiring educators and homemakers with logically recreated abacus books and 15 years of teaching expertise.
officialBlogs.content: At ANABACUS (ANA KNOWLEDGE ARENA PVT. LTD.), our slogan is 'LEARN ABACUS WHILE PLAYING'. With 15 years of deep and vast experience in abacus teaching and as an abacus school owner, Dr. Ananya Das Mahapatra has designed an instructor training program that combines logical, easy-to-learn abacus books with classroom meditation and mental gym techniques.

officialBlogs.title: How Anabacus Training Supports Math Skill Improvement
officialBlogs.author: Ananya DM
officialBlogs.summary: Through hands-on practice on the abacus beads, students gain a visual understanding that allows them to quickly grasp concepts behind arithmetic operations.
officialBlogs.content: Our teachers take extra care for Abacus training for the students. It helps the children to calculate the maths faster and makes the subject easy. Through hands-on practice on the abacus beads, students gain a visual understanding that leads to excellent academic progression.

officialBlogs.title: What Are Abacus Learning Methods? Making Numbers Come Alive
officialBlogs.author: Ananya DM
officialBlogs.summary: Explore how physical bead manipulation transitions into Visualization, Photographic Memory, and rapid Mental Maths.
officialBlogs.content: Abacus learning methods at ANABACUS begin with tactile bead movement on rods and systematically build Visualization—the ability to represent numbers and equations as mental pictures—activating both left and right hemispheres of the brain.

officialBlogs.title: Inside Look: Abacus Institute Features and Gallery
officialBlogs.author: Ananya DM
officialBlogs.summary: A tour inside our Dum Dum Cantonment Head Office and branches across Madhyamgram, Habra, New Barrackpore, and Mohanpur.
officialBlogs.content: Come experience our amazing learning centre and meet our community of involved parents and teachers. Beyond abacus calculation, we integrate Handwriting alignment, Rubik's Cube solving, Mental Gym, and Meditation for the holistic relaxation and growth of every child.

officialBlogs.title: Enhance Your Skills with Abacus Training Insights
officialBlogs.author: Ananya DM
officialBlogs.summary: How concentration skill, logical reasoning, and recall work together during daily abacus practice.
officialBlogs.content: When using an abacus, a child concentrates on the beads and rods and their position in the tool. This improves focus, attention span, numeric memory, and instant recall during school exams.

Our Institutional Mission

Wholesome Whole-Brain Education for Every Child

"We believe that every child should have access to a wholesome educational experience that stimulates their imagination, creativity, and social skills. Our mission at ANABACUS (ANA KNOWLEDGE ARENA PVT. LTD.) is to empower children to grow into happy, well-balanced, and responsible global citizens while eliminating math phobia through our signature 'Learn Abacus While Playing' methodology."

Key Highlights & Benefits

Why Choose ANABACUS?

Designed by Founder Dr. Ananya Das Mahapatra with logically recreated abacus books and holistic brain-gym activities.

🧠

Whole Brain Development

Synchronizes both Left (logical analysis) and Right (visualization, creativity & photographic memory) brain hemispheres during the peak 4 to 14 years developmental window.

🏅

Structured 10-Level Curriculum

9 structured progressive levels plus the 'anakid' foundation module, complete with logically recreated workbooks, official Abacus toolkits, and completion diplomas.

🎮

Play-Way Methodology

True to our motto "Learn Abacus While Playing", classes integrate stress-free interactive number games, classroom Meditation, Mental Gym, and Rubik's Cube activities.

💻

Flexible Learning Modes

Learn at our offline centres across West Bengal or join Live Interactive 1-on-1 & Small Group Online Classes conducted in English, বাংলা, हिंदी & Odia.

Structured Progression

Course & Level Structure at a Glance

Each level takes approximately 3–4 months with just 15 minutes of daily practice.

Ages 4 – 6 Yrs

Foundation 'anakid'

Number recognition, bead touch familiarity, basic single-digit addition & subtraction without formulas, and finger dexterity.

Elementary

Levels 1 – 3

Small Friends (±5) & Big Friends (±10) complements, 1 & 2-digit multi-step addition/subtraction, and introduction to bead visualization.

Intermediate

Levels 4 – 6

Multi-step 2 & 3-digit operations, Abacus Multiplication (2D×1D, 3D×1D), Division (2D÷1D, 3D÷1D), and rapid Flash Anzan.

Master Visualization

Levels 7 – 9

High-speed 6 to 8-step mental arithmetic, double-digit multiplication (2D×2D, 3D×2D), master division, and blindfold mental math.

Co-Curricular

Skill Boosters

Handwriting alignment & speed, 3×3 Rubik's Cube solving, Photographic Memory drills, and Teacher Training / Franchise programs.

How Learning Works at ANABACUS

01

Free Demo & Counseling

Book a free demo session at our nearest centre or online to assess your child's age and learning comfort.

02

Kit & Level Enrollment

Receive the official ANABACUS Soroban toolkit and logically recreated workbooks tailored to your child's starting level.

03

Weekly Classes + 15m Practice

Attend engaging weekly classes paired with 15 minutes of daily practice and interactive Virtual Abacus Test drills.

04

Assessment & Diploma

Complete each 3–4 month level assessment to earn official diplomas and advance to mental visualization mastery.

Frequently Asked Questions

Children aged 4 to 14 years are in their peak brain development window and can join our student levels (starting with anakid for 4–6 yrs or Level 1 for 7+ yrs). For our Teacher Training (Course Instructor) & Franchise programs, there is no age limit!
Each level takes approximately 3 to 4 months to complete. Just 15 minutes of daily practice using our workbooks and the interactive Virtual Abacus Test portal on this website is sufficient for remarkable speed and accuracy.
Yes! We have offline centres at Dum Dum Cantonment (Head Office), Madhyamgram, Habra, Mohanpur, New Barrackpore (Windmere & Magnolia Society), Dunlop, Heria, and Ghatal, as well as Live Interactive Online batches in English, Bengali, Hindi, and Odia.
Students receive the official ANABACUS toolkit, logically recreated level workbooks authored under Dr. Ananya Das Mahapatra, access to our 7-rod Virtual Abacus Test (with Standard, Flashing Values, and Voice Dictation modes), and an official diploma after passing each level.

customSections.page-academics:
Abacus Courses for Kids

ACADEMICS AT ANABACUS

"Abacus is a must nowadays. It has already begun in different schools, as this would help students develop themselves. Abacus is an ability that helps to build a mind that is powerful and consistent. It is about studying quick equations that can be used by students in their everyday lives. In today's age, a person needs to have a different talent that will help them excel in the future. We give Abacus Courses for kids."

8 Core Brain & Skill Development Pillars

Click "Learn More" on any skill card below to view how ANABACUS trains your child in that domain.

👁️

Visualization

Visualization is the ability to create an image in an individual's mind, which has a perception of their surroundings. It is also known as the skill to represent information, data or process in the form of mental pictures. It is seen that Abacus learning enhances visualization in the young minds.

🎯

Concentration Skill

The use of abacus for mental calculations helps to improve the concentration skills of kids. When using an abacus, a kid has to concentrate on the beads and rods, and their position in the tool. This helps to improve the focus and attention span of the kids and this helps them to perform other tasks that require concentration and attention to detail.

🧩

Logical Reasoning

Logical reasoning, an indispensable skill in mathematics, forms the bedrock of a child's mathematical development. The abacus, a centuries-old counting tool, emerges as a powerful instrument in nurturing logical thinking and fostering a profound understanding of fundamental mathematical concepts.

📸

Photographic Memory

During abacus training, children are required to memorise the abacus and various other images to solve problems. They visualise the beads and recite them in their minds. It helps in amplifying their numeric memory and improving their photographic memory. With continuous practice, your children become proficient in memorising things what they see.

⚡

Recall

Recall is a word that you would have certainly heard a lot many times. Basically, it is an activity of remembering anything that has been learnt or experienced in the past. Let us understand why recall is important in a student's life.

🧠

Mental Maths

In fact, the brain consists of the left and right hemispheres. Each hemisphere focuses on specific tasks. While the left hemisphere is responsible for analysing information, the right hemisphere focuses on creative thinking, concentration, and visualisation. Abacus proves to be effective in training the right brain.

✍️

Handwriting

A good handwriting is a pleasure both to the student and to the examiner. Only with good alignment can good handwriting be obtained. There are certain rules which when followed will lead to a good handwriting. Handwriting is something which should be inculcated from the beginning. Just a bit of concentration and practice is required.

🎲

Rubik's Cube

Rubik's Cube plays a significant role as a brain activity as it helps children to refine their brain, boost memory & confidence etc. They partake in these events that help them keep their brains engaged. These brain-related tasks often keep every individual entertained and their minds occupied. This puts kids in comfort mode.
